name: lSEuroCurrencyFormat
description: this function is just an alias for lsCurrencyFormat
syntax: lSEuroCurrencyFormat( object number, [string type], [locale locale], [boolean useBrackets] )

params.name: type
params.description:
one of the following:

- local (the currency format used in the locale. (default) )
- international (the international standard currency format of the locale)
- none (the currency format used in the locale; no currency symbol)

params.name: locale
params.description: Locale to use instead of the locale of the page when processing the function

params.name: useBrackets
params.description: When a number is negative, by default, it is wrapped in brackets
